summary: Complaints centre on unpaid sugarcane dues owed by the Bajaj mill in the Nagal area, with farmers also raising crop-protection and power demands; most positives and several negatives remain unverified inference.

positives.english: From Rampur Maniharan I can get a bus or train to Delhi
positives.hindi: रामपुर मनिहारन से दिल्ली तक बस और रेल मिल जाती है
positives.basis: Wikipedia (Rampur Maniharan town page, accessed 2026-10-12): 'situated 15 km from Saharanpur on the NH 709B and has bus and rail connections to Delhi.' Town-level, not a dated project.

positives.english: Many medical facilities are available here in town
positives.hindi: यहां इलाज की कई सुविधाएं मिल जाती हैं
positives.basis: Wikipedia (Rampur Maniharan town page, accessed 2026-10-12): 'There are many medical facilities in this town.' No facilities are named and no quality or year is given; a general statement only.

positives.english: We organise and hand over memoranda, so our demands reach officials
positives.hindi: हम संगठित होकर ज्ञापन देकर अपनी बात अधिकारियों तक पहुंचा पाते हैं
positives.basis: Saharanpur district-level: BKU Verma workers handed a memorandum addressed to the Governor to DM Akhilesh Singh (Amar Ujala, Sat 7 Jan 2023). Verified by fetch. Not AC-specific.

positives.english: * Sugarcane is our cash crop, and it gets sold to the mill nearby
positives.hindi: * गन्ना यहाँ की नकदी फसल है, जो पास की मिल में बिक जाता है
positives.basis: Inference: not stated as a positive by any source. Context only: Royal Bulletin (5 Oct 2026) says the Gangnauli Bajaj mill owes Rs 88.51 crore of cane value for the 2025-26 season, so cane is supplied to a local mill. That does not show cane is the main cash crop.

positives.english: * Some families get a few days of work under MGNREGA
positives.hindi: * मनरेगा से कुछ परिवारों को थोड़ा काम मिल जाता है
positives.basis: Inference: no source confirms MGNREGA work in this AC. The 2023 Saharanpur memorandum (Amar Ujala, 7 Jan 2023) only demanded that farming be linked with MGNREGA labour, which is a demand, not evidence the scheme operates.

negatives.english: The Bajaj mill in Nagal still owes crores of rupees for our sugarcane
negatives.hindi: नगल की बजाज मिल पर हमारे गन्ने के करोड़ों रुपये बकाया हैं
negatives.basis: Royal Bulletin (5 Oct 2026): DM Arvind Kumar Chauhan reviewed dues; the Bajaj group's Gangnauli mill owes Rs 88.51 crore for the 2025-26 season and the DM rebuked unit head R.B. Khokhar. Amar Ujala (6 Feb 2023) places Gangnauli in the Nagal area; the mill GM was arrested over Rs 21.56 crore dues and released on an affidavit to pay by 12 Feb. Wikipedia names Nagal as part of this AC, but does not name Gangnauli, so AC membership of the mill village is a field check item.

negatives.english: * When it rains, the roads break and the fields fill with water
negatives.hindi: * बारिश में सड़कें टूट जाती हैं और खेतों में पानी भर जाता है
negatives.basis: Inference: the only source found was a CropGPT aggregator summary (16 Jul 2026) about the Deoband region. Its original outlet could not be found, so the source was dropped. No Nagal or Rampur Maniharan road report was found in Hindi press.

negatives.english: * Urea is not given on time at the cooperative societies, which hurts the crop
negatives.hindi: * सहकारी समितियों में यूरिया समय पर नहीं मिलता, फसल पर असर पड़ता है
negatives.basis: Inference: no Saharanpur or Nagal urea report found. Regional context only: Amar Ujala reported urea shortages at cooperative societies in Shamli (May 2026) and Meerut (May 2026). The CropGPT source for the Deoband region was dropped because its original outlet could not be found.

negatives.english: Nilgai and stray animals damage our standing crop
negatives.hindi: हमारी खड़ी फसल को नीलगाय और आवारा पशु नुकसान पहुंचाते हैं
negatives.basis: Saharanpur district-level: BKU Verma's memorandum to DM Akhilesh Singh (Amar Ujala, 7 Jan 2023) demanded protection of crops from stray animals and nilgai. Verified by fetch. Dated 2023; no 2024-26 Saharanpur or AC report found, so persistence is not shown.

negatives.english: We want free electricity for our fields
negatives.hindi: हम चाहते हैं खेतों के लिए बिजली मुफ्त मिले
negatives.basis: Saharanpur district-level: the same BKU Verma memorandum (Amar Ujala, 7 Jan 2023) demanded free electricity for farmers. Verified by fetch. The memo does not say power is costly or cut in this AC, so no such claim is made here.

notes: Voice pass (round 3, text only): English aligned to Hindi on P1, P4, P5, N2 and N3; Hindi and English reworded on P2, P3, N1, N4 and N5. P2 weak positive: general statement, no facilities named and no year given. Identity: AC No. 6, Rampur Maniharan, SC, Saharanpur, confirmed from the Wikipedia AC page (Nagal, Rampur and Rampur Maniharan NP of Deoband tehsil). Nanauta and Gangoh are not named on that page, so they are not treated as part of this AC. Check against the ECI delimitation list before publishing. Verified in round 2: Amar Ujala 7 Jan 2023 memorandum, Amar Ujala 6 Feb 2023 Bajaj GM arrest, Royal Bulletin 5 Oct 2026 dues report, Wikipedia AC and town pages. The CropGPT aggregator (16 Jul 2026, memorandum and Nagal/urea/road claims) was fetched; it states the facts but names no original outlet, and the memorandum itself could not be found in any Hindi outlet, so every CropGPT-based claim was removed or turned into inference. Only one negative names an AC place (Nagal, via the Bajaj mill). Gangnauli village is described as in the Nagal area (Amar Ujala 2023) and in Deoband tehsil (plant directory); confirm it lies inside this AC. Negatives 2 and 3 (roads and urea) and positives 4 and 5 remain inference. Not reached: Dainik Jagran, Hindustan and Patrika Saharanpur editions were not indexed by the search tool for this AC; the Amar Ujala searches returned no Nagal or Rampur Maniharan local news. The ETV Bharat and Himachal Rampur results are a different Rampur and were excluded. Field check: Nagal and Rampur road condition after monsoon, urea availability at the Nagal cooperative society, Gangnauli mill dues for 2025-26, nilgai damage in 2025-26, and local medical facilities named in the town.

round2.changes: Verified Amar Ujala 2023 memorandum (district-level), Amar Ujala 2023 Bajaj GM arrest, Royal Bulletin Oct 2026 Gangnauli dues (new, original outlet), Wikipedia AC and town pages. Removed 5 CropGPT entries (no original outlet found), 2 Wikipedia entries that did not support the claims (ration/welfare, markets), and 1 Amar Ujala entry that only supported a demand (MGNREGA). Replaced positive 1 (cane cash crop) with inference, and swapped weak positives for Wikipedia-sourced town facts (bus/rail, medical facilities). Negative 1 now sourced to Oct 2026 dues report. Negatives 2 and 3 (roads, urea) turned into inference. Negative 4 wording changed to 'damage' to match the memorandum. Negative 5 narrowed to the sourced demand. Ranks re-ordered by likely impact.
